errata.text:
# ERRATA — coding-2

Correction: max_attempts was previously published as 2. The corrected value is 11. The earlier figure is superseded and must not be relied on.

# ERRATA — execution-2

Correction: escalate_after_minutes was previously published as 10. The corrected value is 34. The earlier figure is superseded and must not be relied on.

# ERRATA — reasoning-2

Correction: effect_size was previously published as 0.64. The corrected value is 0.29. The earlier figure is superseded and must not be relied on.

# ERRATA — generation-2

Correction: section_order was previously published as examples-first. The corrected value is faq-first. The earlier figure is superseded and must not be relied on.
